channel.title: Pregnancy Pal docs
channel.description: How each part of Pregnancy Pal works.

item.title: Appearance and units
item.description: One control for colours, light and dark, text size and motion. Readings are shown in the units you choose.

item.title: Claiming an older record
item.description: If we wrote to you about an older account, sign in with the same Google account to bring your record across.

item.title: Export or delete your data
item.description: Your whole record as a file you keep, and deleting your account, on every plan.

item.title: Exercise
item.description: Exercises for your stage with step-by-step instructions, all optional. No streaks.

item.title: Food
item.description: Foods grouped as enjoy, limit or avoid, what to focus on each trimester, and what you do not eat.

item.title: Guides
item.description: Short reads picked from your week. Calm, plain, and clear about when to call someone.

item.title: Suggestions
item.description: Patterns from your own record, worded so you can ask about them. Off until you turn them on.

item.title: Wellness and reminders
item.description: Water, posture, eye breaks, doses and visits. You choose which reminders you want and when they stay quiet.

item.title: Community
item.description: Small rooms by stage. Read without posting, report or block anyone, and posts telling people to change treatment come down.

item.title: Coming from another app
item.description: How to move to Pregnancy Pal from Flo, Clue, Ovia and other pregnancy and cycle apps, with what each offers, read from its own pages.

item.title: Moving from BabyCenter to Pregnancy Pal

item.title: Sign in and set your dates
item.description: Sign in with Google, tell us your stage and dates, and your week is worked out from them.

item.title: Today, your main page
item.description: Your week, your next visit and the things you log most, in one place.

item.title: Contact and policies
item.description: How to reach us, and where the Privacy Policy and Terms live.

item.title: Questions people ask
item.description: Short answers about who it is for, plans, partners, privacy and devices.

item.title: No signal, and updates
item.description: What works offline, how quick logs sync, and how the app keeps itself up to date.

item.title: What Pregnancy Pal is
item.description: One record for before, during and after pregnancy, for you and your partner. What it keeps, what it costs and what it will not do.

item.title: Plans
item.description: What Free, Plus and Family each include, and where the current prices live.

item.title: After the birth
item.description: Feeds with a timer, weight and length, and the vaccinations your clinic gave.

item.title: Periods and fertile days
item.description: Log your periods and get estimates of your next period and fertile days. Estimates are labeled that way everywhere.

item.title: Logging readings and symptoms
item.description: Blood pressure, weight, symptoms, kicks and contractions, each with its date. Your own line, with no borrowed averages.

item.title: Medication
item.description: Copy what was prescribed, tick each dose, and your visit report counts what you took.

item.title: Sharing with a partner
item.description: Nothing is shared until you switch it on. Invite your partner with a link and choose each part they can see.

item.title: The visit report
item.description: One page for your doctor, built live from your own record, with your questions first. Print it or save a PDF.

item.title: Visits and questions
item.description: Keep each visit with its time, place, reminder and notes, and collect questions for the next one.
